tweets.text:
$BTC With a flush during the weekend just like last week.

Price tapped the .618 from the recent leg up and swept the local lows again.

Now price is back above the ~$80K local range low. That is the key area to watch in the week ahead.

All markets have been very shaky last week ahead of the big earnings, FOMC, midterms & geopolitical headlines. Lots of uncertainties, a lot of them will be "gone" or over with in 1-2 weeks from now. That is the key timeline to watch.

quote.text:
$BTC Back to the local range low where it has traded at for a lot of the past two weeks.

Lost both the 4H 200MA/EMA as neither could hold on the way down.

Crypto in itself still showing a lot of relative strength to stocks lately. Whether that's actual strength or just lagging we will see soon enough.

$80K is the level to hold for the bulls. $85K & $87K are the levels to watch above.

Don't get chopped up in the middle.
